name: hemomancer
about: The Hemomancer (Derek's test 1 sheet) as a solid shape sprite: a crown of rusted iron spikes over black locs, dark skin, a crimson cowl and mantle, a tabard down the front and a cape down the back, bare muscular arms with bloody bandaged forearms, a skirt of weathered planks and a plank shield stained with blood, wrapped legs, bare wrapped feet. Drawn around the 120 px author pose.
